welcome.title: A programme shaped around your goals.
welcome.body: Your plan sets how many sessions you have and over what period. Nothing is scheduled for you and no curriculum is assigned — each session covers whatever you bring to it.

goals.title: Name what you want to change.
goals.body: Write one to three goals in your own words and rate each 1-10 today. The rating is a starting line, not a judgement, and only you can change it.

bullets.label: Specific
bullets.text: 'Hold a hard conversation without softening it' beats 'communicate better'.

bullets.label: Yours
bullets.text: Rewrite, split, or drop a goal at any point in the programme.

bullets.label: Rated
bullets.text: Re-rate whenever something shifts — that movement is your progress.

coach.title: Choose your coach.
coach.body: Your goals filter the accredited network down to the coaches who work on exactly that. Read profiles, book a free 20-minute chemistry call, and decide after you've met.

bullets.label: Filter
bullets.text: By focus area, language, and availability this month.

bullets.label: Meet first
bullets.text: Chemistry calls don't count against your session allowance.

bullets.label: Switch once
bullets.text: You can change coach mid-programme without giving a reason.

book.title: Book session one.
book.body: You see your coach's live availability and pick a slot. Reminders, the video link, and rescheduling all live in the session — no email chains.

privacy.title: The session is a closed room.
privacy.body: Notes, recordings, your goal wording, and everything you say belong to you and your coach. Nothing leaves that room unless you send it yourself.

bullets.label: You control
bullets.text: What you write, what you share, and who you invite in.

bullets.label: Never exposed
bullets.text: Session notes, recordings, and the wording of your goals.

bullets.label: Your coach
bullets.text: Keeps private prep notes too; only summaries marked shared reach you.

progress.title: Progress is your own rating, moving.
progress.body: Your dashboard tracks each goal's rating across every session you have. No score is calculated for you, and there is no ranking — the line moves when you say it moved.

findCoaches.title: Find coaches is your starting point.
findCoaches.body: Profiles, chemistry calls, and live calendars all sit here. It stays open for the whole programme, including if you switch coach.

nextSession.title: Your next session, always first.
nextSession.body: Topic, coach, and time. Open it to add what you want to cover — your coach sees that, nobody else does.

sessionLog.title: What you agreed to, in one place.
sessionLog.body: Every session leaves its log entry and its action items here. Tick them off as you go — this is also where you re-rate a goal after something shifts.

welcome.title: Your practice, on one surface.
welcome.body: Matching, booking, reminders, notes, and session history sit in one place — for the clients you coach and for your own practice as a coachee and peer. You keep your method; the platform removes the admin around it.

profile.title: Complete your coach profile.
profile.body: Your specialties, experience, and languages are what the matching runs on. A thin profile simply doesn't surface when a coachee filters by their goal.

bullets.label: Specialties
bullets.text: Pick the two or three you genuinely work in, not everything you could.

bullets.label: Bio
bullets.text: One paragraph in your own voice — it appears on every match card.

bullets.label: Accreditation
bullets.text: Credentials are verified once, then shown as a badge on your profile.

availability.title: Publish your availability.
availability.body: Nobody can book you until windows are open. Set recurring weekly blocks in your own timezone; the platform converts them for each coachee and holds buffers between sessions.

bullets.label: Recurring
bullets.text: Set once, repeats weekly. Close any individual week when you need to.

bullets.label: Buffers
bullets.text: Add gaps so back-to-back sessions can't be booked.

bullets.label: Chemistry calls
bullets.text: Reserve a short weekly window for 20-minute intro calls.

practice.title: Coach, and be coached.
practice.body: Clariva is also where your own practice grows. Opt in to peer coaching to exchange sessions with other accredited coaches, book a coach for yourself, and keep your practice hours in one record.

bullets.label: Peer exchange
bullets.text: Give a session, receive a session. Both count as peer sessions on your dashboard.

bullets.label: Your own coach
bullets.text: Find a coach works exactly as it does for a coachee — you are the coachee there.

bullets.label: Practice journey
bullets.text: Sessions delivered, peer sessions, and reflections build the record behind your accreditation.

privacy.title: Your notes stay in the room.
privacy.body: Organisations fund programmes but have no route into sessions. That boundary is enforced by the product, not by policy.

bullets.label: Organisations see
bullets.text: That a session happened, its length, and attendance.

bullets.label: They never see
bullets.text: Notes, recordings, or your name against a named individual.

bullets.label: Your coachee sees
bullets.text: Only the summaries you mark as shared. Prep notes stay private.

flags.title: The platform flags who is stalling.
flags.body: Flat goal ratings and long booking gaps surface on your dashboard before a programme runs out of sessions. Nudges go out from you, never from anyone's employer.

availability.title: My availability comes first.
availability.body: Until there are open windows here, matched coachees see you as fully booked. It is the one screen to visit before anything else.

nextSession.title: Next session, with context.
nextSession.body: Topic, client, and time — coaching and peer sessions both surface here. Open it to review your last notes before you join.

bookingRequests.title: Approve or decline in one tap.
bookingRequests.body: Requests land here with topic, length, and time. Approving confirms the slot and sends the meeting link; declining frees the window immediately.

welcome.title: Programme health, without the content.
welcome.body: You can see whether your cohort is engaged and whether people are moving. You cannot see coaching. That trade is what makes the sessions candid enough to work.

timing.title: Know where the cohort sits in time.
timing.body: Every figure is read against the programme window. Six sessions across four months means low usage in month one is normal and flat ratings in month three are not.

enrolment.title: Close out enrolment.
enrolment.body: Eleven of twelve leaders have accepted. Open the roster, find who hasn't, and send a reminder — it arrives from the programme, not from a manager.

bullets.label: Invite
bullets.text: Add leaders by email; each one picks their own coach.

bullets.label: Nudge
bullets.text: One tap for anyone who hasn't enrolled or hasn't booked.

bullets.label: At risk
bullets.text: Flags appear automatically after five weeks with no session.

withheld.title: What is withheld, and why.
withheld.body: Restrictions appear in the product as visible locked items, so you always know what exists rather than wondering what you're missing.

bullets.label: You see
bullets.text: Enrolment, attendance, sessions used, on-track status, goal growth.

bullets.label: You never see
bullets.text: Notes, recordings, goal wording, or an individual's chosen coach.

bullets.label: Under five people
bullets.text: Distributions are suppressed and only the cohort average shows.

metrics.title: Two numbers renew a programme.
metrics.body: On-track rate says whether people are showing up. Average goal growth says whether anything changed. Export both for any period, with or without the roster.

navigation.title: Three screens, no fourth.
navigation.body: There is no route from here into session content. The absence is deliberate — nothing sits behind a permission you could request later.

cohortFilter.title: One cohort at a time.
cohortFilter.body: Switch cohort here and every figure below follows, including the roster and the export.

roster.title: Status, not stories.
roster.body: Enrolment, sessions used, and self-rated growth per person. Rows don't open into content — they open into the same aggregates plus what's withheld.
